full_judgment:
He denied suggestion put from defence side that the occurrence did not take place in the manner and, also, at the time and place according to his version. He did not know the plot and khatian number and the quantity of the place of occurrence land. He did not know whether accused Khabir filed any case against Kabir Khan, his two sons and the witnesses of the case before the Office of Divisional Commissioner for an area of 25.53 acres of land. He, also, denied the suggestion that deceased Kabir Khan had many enemies and in the darkness of night he was murdered by his enemies. 

 29. PW 20 Shahabuddin was officer-in-charge of the Bhanga Police Station at the relevant time. He registered first information report, filled up Form, performed Inquest, seized Alamats and on investigation laid Police Report in the form of charge-sheet against accused persons. He caused the seizure of incriminating articles at 19-30 hours on going to place of occurrence. He did not mention that nut plants were stained with blood. He did not seize any paper in respect of place of occurrence and there had been no mention of plot and khatian number of place of occurrence. He did not seize wearing lungi (a kind of loin cloth) of deceased Kabir Khan. He blurted out in his evidence that recording of statement under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure was not under his hand and statements were recorded by TSI and charge-sheet was, also, not written down by him. He stated that he only put his signature on Index, Inquest Report and seizure list. 

 45. In first information report the place of occurrence had been noted "Baliahati" which is produced in verbatim: ঘটনাস্থলঃ বালিয়াহাটি I It came out from the mouth of informant (PW 1) that place of occurrence was Baliahati Mouza. Statement is extracted in words: বালিয়াহাটি মৌজা ছিল ঘটনাস্থল No particular place had been fixed in first information report. From the version of Informant (PW 1) no particular scene of incident came out. Prosecution mounted an endeavour to locate the Nut field of deceased Kabir Khan as the place of occurrence. But in support of ownership of deceased Kabir Khan over Nut field, no paper and document had been filed in Court. Informant PW 1 could not also state khatian and plot number of the alleged place of occurrence. Version furnished by informant (PW 1) is to the following effect: আমি দাগ, খতিয়ান ও পরিমান কিছুই জানিনা।
